instruction: Contrast the features of iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 14 Pro, and iPhone 13 Pro.

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing iPhone 15 Pro with iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 13 Pro. The evaluator uses get_active_tab_url_parse to extract the modelList query parameter from the Apple compare URL and verifies it contains the three expected iPhone models. No custom functions needed as we reuse existing evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction by extracting modelList query parameter from active tab URL
Metric appropriately uses ignore_list_order to allow comparison models in any order
Expected values match Apple's URL format for product comparison (iphone-15-pro, iphone-14-pro, iphone-13-pro)
Complete coverage: all three required iPhone models are verified in the comparison
Getter can successfully extract URL from accessibility tree and parse query parameters
Minor issue: No postconfig to ensure compare page remains active, but acceptable for URL-based verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to reopen/refresh the compare page if needed for robustness
Optional: Add fallback verification to check page title or content to ensure comparison page loaded successfully
